notes: ILLUSTRATION ONLY, not a verified recipe for any real application. This exists to show the fileName+sizeBytes fallback match shape (see README.md) for a common category of app: a .NET Framework 4.8 desktop installer literally named Setup.exe, which is an extremely generic file name — plenty of unrelated installers share it. sizeBytes (50 MiB here) is a made-up round number, not measured from a real file. Do not rely on this recipe matching anything real; if you have an actual installer named Setup.exe, run `winbridge recipe show` on it and write a sha256-keyed recipe instead, which is exact instead of merely plausible. WinBridge does not fabricate hashes of real software as if verified, and this file does not either.
